rationale: Record that the release smoke change crosses the design-output-and-packaging selector through release-cli.yml. The Unix smoke legs additionally install the built CLI archive through the default branch's install.sh (new PULP_INSTALL_ARCHIVE local-archive input) into a scratch root and check every installed Mach-O dependency resolves, then launch pulp-cpp and pulp-mcp from it; tools/install/SHA256SUMS is regenerated. The archive contents, packaging, build steps and publication are unchanged. No importer, DesignIR schema, browser capture path, renderer, codegen output, fixture, threshold or Vellum-owned source changes, and no existing test's verdict changes. Registered as watch-only so the family's coverage stays honest about a change that crossed its selector. No authority moves and no Vellum artifact changes.
